# Test data

Every committed file under `testdata/` is either written for this project (covered by the
project license, `MIT OR Apache-2.0`) or copied from a third-party corpus whose license is
noted below. No fixture contains real correspondence: names and addresses use reserved
example domains (`example.com`, `*.example`, `stv.test`).

| Directory | What | Origin | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`pst/`](pst/README.md) | three synthetic PST/OST stores (ANSI/permute, Unicode/cyclic, 4K-page/zlib OST) | generated by `crates/pst/tests/common/mod.rs` | project license |
| [`mbox/`](mbox/README.md) | mbox variants, Thunderbird and Apple Mail trees, `.eml` folders, corrupt inputs | generated by `crates/mbox/tests/common/mod.rs` | project license |
| [`msg/poi/`](msg/README.md) | real-world `.msg` and TNEF samples | Apache POI test corpus, unmodified | Apache-2.0 (see `NOTICE`) |
| [`library/`](library/README.md) | one small conversation split across an mbox and `.eml` files | hand-written | project license |
| [`app/`](app/README.md) | `demo.mbox`, demo mailbox for the desktop app and screenshots | generated by `app/scripts/make-fixtures.mjs` | project license |
| `large/` | multi-GB real-world archives for local testing (git-ignored) | downloaded; see [`pst/README.md`](pst/README.md) | per source |

Tests that need `testdata/large/` skip themselves (with a note) when the files are absent,
so CI and fresh clones run the full suite on the committed fixtures alone.
